verdict.rationale: Brex marketing mentions 'fast global payments' (brex-docs-10) and a Payments API for ACH/wires/checks (brex-docs-12), but there is no documented support for sending payments in local currencies or any transparent fee schedule for international transfers. Missing for 10: explicit local-currency payment rails, FX rate/fee transparency documentation, and evidence of international payment reliability beyond a single marketing tagline.
